segments.text: V. 6. Here is another Inſtance of that Tranſpoſition, where, of the two Things propoſed, the latter is firſt treated of. Give not—to d••s—l•ſt turning they rend you: Caſt not—to ſwine—left they trample them under ſcot.

Yet even then, when the le•m is caſt out of thine own eye, Give not —That is, Talk not of the deep things of God, to thoſe whom you know to be wallowing in Sin; neither declare the great things GOD hath done for your Soul, to the profane, furious, perſecuting Wretches. Talk not of Perfection, for Inſtance, to the former; not of your own Experience, to the latter. But our LORD does in no wife forbid us to reprove, as Occaſion is, both the one and the other.
